class.name: OcgGpQuaternion
class.brief_description: Represents operation of rotation in 3d space as quaternion and implements operations with rotations basing on quaternion mathematics.
class.description: ! Represents operation of rotation in 3d space as quaternion ! and implements operations with rotations basing on ! quaternion mathematics. ! ! In addition, provides methods for conversion to and from other ! representations of rotation (3*3 matrix, vector and ! angle, Euler angles)

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an identity quaternion

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates quaternion from rotation matrix 3*3 (which should be orthonormal skew-symmetric matrix)

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates quaternion representing shortest-arc rotation operator producing vector theVecTo from vector theVecFrom.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates quaternion representing rotation on angle theAngle around vector theAxis

method.name: from_5
method.description: Creates quaternion representing shortest-arc rotation operator producing vector theVecTo from vector theVecFrom. Additional vector theHelpCrossVec defines preferred direction for rotation and is used when theVecTo and theVecFrom are directed oppositely.

method.name: from_6
method.description: Creates quaternion directly from component values

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Simple equal test without precision

method.name: SetRotation_1
method.description: Sets quaternion to shortest-arc rotation producing vector theVecTo from vector theVecFrom. If vectors theVecFrom and theVecTo are opposite then rotation axis is computed as theVecFrom ^ (1,0,0) or theVecFrom ^ (0,0,1).

method.name: SetRotation_2
method.description: Sets quaternion to shortest-arc rotation producing vector theVecTo from vector theVecFrom. If vectors theVecFrom and theVecTo are opposite then rotation axis is computed as theVecFrom ^ theHelpCrossVec.

method.name: SetVectorAndAngle
method.description: Create a unit quaternion from Axis+Angle representation

method.name: GetVectorAndAngle
method.description: Convert a quaternion to Axis+Angle representation, preserve the axis direction and angle from -PI to +PI

method.name: SetMatrix
method.description: Create a unit quaternion by rotation matrix matrix must contain only rotation (not scale or shear)

method.name: GetMatrix
method.description: Returns rotation operation as 3*3 matrix

method.name: SetEulerAngles
method.description: Create a unit quaternion representing rotation defined by generalized Euler angles

method.name: GetEulerAngles
method.description: Returns Euler angles describing current rotation

method.name: SetIdent
method.description: Make identity quaternion (zero-rotation)

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Reverse direction of rotation (conjugate quaternion)

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Return rotation with reversed direction (conjugated quaternion)

method.name: Invert
method.description: Inverts quaternion (both rotation direction and norm)

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Return inversed quaternion q^-1

method.name: SquareNorm
method.description: Returns square norm of quaternion

method.name: Norm
method.description: Returns norm of quaternion

method.name: Scale
method.description: Scale all components by quaternion by theScale; note that rotation is not changed by this operation (except 0-scaling)

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Returns scaled quaternion

method.name: StabilizeLength
method.description: Stabilize quaternion length within 1 - 1/4. This operation is a lot faster than normalization and preserve length goes to 0 or infinity

method.name: Normalize
method.description: Scale quaternion that its norm goes to 1. The appearing of 0 magnitude or near is a error, so we can be sure that can divide by magnitude

method.name: Normalized
method.description: Returns quaternion scaled so that its norm goes to 1.

method.name: Negated
method.description: Returns quaternion with all components negated. Note that this operation does not affect neither rotation operator defined by quaternion nor its norm.

method.name: Added
method.description: Makes sum of quaternion components; result is "rotations mix"

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: Makes difference of quaternion components; result is "rotations mix"

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Multiply function - work the same as Matrices multiplying. Result is rotation combination: q' than q (here q=this, q'=theQ). Notices that:

method.name: Add
method.description: Adds components of other quaternion; result is "rotations mix"

method.name: Subtract
method.description: Subtracts components of other quaternion; result is "rotations mix"

method.name: Multiply_1
method.description: Adds rotation by multiplication

method.name: Dot
method.description: Computes inner product / scalar product / Dot

method.name: GetRotationAngle
method.description: Return rotation angle from -PI to PI

method.name: Multiply_2
method.description: Rotates vector by quaternion as rotation operator
